req.title: Task deletion persists
req.statement: The system shall remove deleted rows so subsequent GET returns 404 for that id.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that a deleted task should not be retrievable, ensuring data consistency and integrity. The test suite includes a positive test to confirm successful deletion, a negative test to handle non-existent task deletion, and a boundary test to check behavior at the edge of valid task IDs.

tests.name: test_delete_existing_task
preconditions: A task with a specific ID exists in the database.
actions: Send a DELETE request to the /tasks/{task_id} endpoint with the existing task ID.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Create a task to ensure it exists
create_response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Test Task", "description": "Test Description", "completed": False})
assert create_response.status_code == 201
created_task_id = create_response.json()["id"]

# Delete the created task
response = client.delete(f"/tasks/{created_task_id}")
assert response.status_code == 204

# Verify the task is deleted
get_response = client.get(f"/tasks/{created_task_id}")
assert get_response.status_code == 404

tests.name: test_delete_non_existent_task
preconditions: No task exists with the specified ID.
actions: Send a DELETE request to the /tasks/{task_id} endpoint with a non-existent task ID.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Attempt to delete a non-existent task
non_existent_task_id = 99999
response = client.delete(f"/tasks/{non_existent_task_id}")
assert response.status_code == 404
assert response.json()["detail"] == f"Task with id {non_existent_task_id} not found"

tests.name: test_delete_task_boundary_id
preconditions: A task with ID 1 exists in the database.
actions: Send a DELETE request to the /tasks/{task_id} endpoint with task ID 1.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Create a task with ID 1
create_response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Boundary Task", "description": "Boundary Description", "completed": False})
assert create_response.status_code == 201
created_task_id = create_response.json()["id"]

# Ensure the task ID is 1 for boundary testing
assert created_task_id == 1

# Delete the task with ID 1
response = client.delete(f"/tasks/{created_task_id}")
assert response.status_code == 204

# Verify the task is deleted
get_response = client.get(f"/tasks/{created_task_id}")
assert get_response.status_code == 404
